Description

Whether you're playing casually or in a team, you'll struggle to find better cricketing facilities than Beverley Park in the South West London area. The brilliant cricket pitch, played on grass, is one of the best places in London to play. With facilities like cricket pitches and cricket nets in London being either fully booked or not local enough, Beverley Park provides an excellent solution to those issues.

It is the ideal evening activity during the cricket season, whether you’re playing with friends or your team. The nature of cricket practise means you can also just turn up and join a game.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one off basis. Their pay as you play system means that you can book now and play without being a member. This gives you the freedom to play a one off game without having to pay a monthly membership fee.

If a one-off game isn't enough, then why not take advantage of the block booking option at Beverley Park? Block bookings are a great way to guarantee a weekly game and socialise with your friends. It also takes the hassle out of paying before each game and collecting money from teammates as there is a one-time payment.

The venue is situated near Shannon Corner / Beverley Way Bus Stop, located within 150m of the park.
